coordinateSystem: EPSG:4326; distances use local metric projection
graphDerivation: 1.6m grid inside public walkway/lobby/elevator/entry polygons, 0.25m precision tolerance, segment containment checked; two connected floor components retained
vertical-pairing: manual/demo augmentation: official lift points at G/F and 1/F paired within 1m; shaft continuity and public access unverified
building-exit: manual/demo augmentation: zero-distance handoff from indoor endpoint to exterior
station-link: Official CSDI pedestrian route geometries; endpoint attachments separately marked manual/demo augmentation
accessibility: All graph edges wheelchair=unknown. Demo mode penalizes uncertainty. Strict mode blocks it. No route is certified accessible.
limitations: No verified opening hours or lift status
No observed door widths or slopes
Selected endpoints are public corridor demo points

outdoor-attachment.method: 3D nearest candidate endpoints (building max 30 m / station max 20 m), minimum route cost with snap penalty; no straight link replaces failed routing

outdoorLimitations: Official WheelchairBarrier and Gradient exclude known barriers/steep slopes; retained accessibility stays unknown
AccessTimeID retained, opening schedules not yet enforced
Single official exterior path retained; full local network preserved for future alternative routing
